title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Society — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Xã hội — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Describe a person in your community who helps others.

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: There is an elderly woman in my neighbourhood who volunteer at the local community centre every weekend. She organises free English classes for children whose families cannot afford private tutoring. What I admire most is that she never complains, even when only a few students turn up. Her dedication truly inspire everyone around her, and many younger residents now want to follow her example. I believe she represent the best of what community spirit means. People like her deserve much more recognition from local government.

errors.explanation: The relative pronoun 'who' refers to 'an elderly woman' (singular), so the verb needs -s: 'volunteers'.
errors.explanationVi: Đại từ quan hệ 'who' thay thế cho 'an elderly woman' (số ít), nên động từ cần -s: 'volunteers'.

errors.explanation: 'Her dedication' is a singular noun phrase — the verb needs -s: 'inspires'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Her dedication' là cụm danh từ số ít — động từ cần -s: 'inspires'.
'She' là ngôi thứ ba số ít — dùng 'represents', không phải 'represent'.

falseAlarmZones.text: she never complains, even when only a few students turn up
falseAlarmZones.hint: 'She never complains' is correct — 'she' is singular, so 'complains' has the correct -s. 'Turn up' is also correct because 'students' is plural.

collocations.exampleSentence: The community centre offers free activities for elderly residents.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Community centre' (British) / 'community center' (American) — cả hai đều chấp nhận trong IELTS

collocations.translation: đủ khả năng thuê gia sư
collocations.exampleSentence: Many families in rural areas cannot afford private tutoring for their children.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Afford + danh từ' hoặc 'afford + to V' — 'cannot afford' phủ định tự nhiên

collocations.exampleSentence: Volunteering at local events strengthens community spirit.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Community spirit' — không dùng 'community soul' hay 'community mind'

collocations.exampleSentence: Many young people want to follow her example and volunteer regularly.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Follow someone's example' — không dùng 'follow someone's model' hay 'follow someone's way'

collocations.exampleSentence: Teachers deserve more recognition for the hard work they do every day.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Deserve + danh từ' trực tiếp — không dùng 'deserve for recognition'

generationMatrix.discourseSituation: A confident learner describing an admirable community volunteer
